known_disclosures: metadata.json holds absolute paths of the exporting machine (argv, suite config). They are not secrets; editing them would break the bundle's checksums, so they are kept and disclosed.

The bundle holds case/trial ids, normalized scores, statuses, per-unit cost/latency, trace ids and the two version manifests (system prompt, tool schema, params). It holds no captured transcripts, answers or credentials.

Native anthropic SDK spans and Vigil spans were both stored for every model call of this run (the SDK double-accounting fixed in 0e68bd9); see span-accounting.json. The unit costs above come from Postgres and are single-counted.
